hint: captures a todo, note, or link
title: Capture without leaving
description: Start with ; and a target, then just keep typing. #tags, due: dates, and p1–p4 priority are read straight out of the sentence, so there's no form to fill in.

examples.note: A task on today's Day Page, due Friday
Type ; alone to pick from every capture target

title: Jump to Today
description: Press ` on the empty main menu to open today's Day Page, the running page where your ;todo captures land.

title: Use what's focused
description: The line above the input names what's focused: the front app's window, or text you selected. Press Space on the empty input to put it in play, then pick what to do with it.

examples.note: Stages the front window or your selected text

title: Use what just happened
description: The footer's left corner shows the most recent thing that ran. Press ↑ at the top of the list, or click it, to put it in play.

examples.note: Stages the last run: run it again, undo it, or share it

title: Mention context
description: Type @ to pull files, clipboard entries, notes, calendar events, and more into what you're asking. Add a source and a colon to search only that source.

examples.note: Picks a calendar event as context

title: Run a command
description: Type / to browse every command, then keep typing to narrow it down.

title: Filter with key:value
description: Put a key:value anywhere in your search to narrow the list. Filters combine with plain words.

examples.note: Only items with a keyboard shortcut

title: Browse files
description: Type ~ on the empty main menu to browse your home folder. Keep typing a path to drill in.

title: Quick terminal
description: Type ! on the empty main menu to open a terminal right in the window.

title: Ask AI about anything
description: Select any row and press ⌘↵ to open Agent Chat with it already staged as context.

examples.note: Opens Agent Chat about the selected row

title: Quick AI question
description: Tap {mainHotkey} twice from anywhere to open a clean Agent Chat with no context attached.

title: Actions menu
description: Press ⌘K to see everything you can do with the focused item. Type to filter the actions, Enter to run one.

examples.note: Lists actions for the focused row
Lets go; the list comes back as it was

title: Open this help
description: Type ? on the empty main menu to come back here. Search tips by key or by word.

hint: Typing searches scripts, notes, clipboard, history
title: One search, every source
description: Plain typing searches scripts, flows, Brain notes, clipboard history, and browser history together.

examples.note: Scripts, Brain notes, and history in one list
Clipboard matches right beside your scripts
